operational_notes: If submission stops partway, jobs.json blocks blind rerun. Reconcile existing submitted jobs and genuine dependencies explicitly; do not delete the record or repeat the whole campaign.

Post-submission scheduler and dependency verification is a separate gate; no production scheduler state is claimed by this static audit.
